# G4.7 RichText Rendering Foundation Implementation Plan v0.1
## 0. Goal
在 G4.6 PASS 之后、G5 之前 materialize production RichText layout/display path、font resource behavior 与 deterministic text workload，使 G5 可以统一优化真实 text + brush + interaction workload。
**Primary Artifact:** Axiom Text Performance Playground 0.1 + Pre-G5 Performance Primitive Inventory + deterministic RichText workload corpus + G4.7 Gate Report。
## 0.1 Execution Dependency
必须满足：
- G4 v0.2 Gate PASS；
- G4.5 Gate PASS；
- G4.6 Gate PASS；
- <mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/3e04c57a590c81a0a7c9fcdb11e1b089"/> accepted output present；
- G4.7 Architecture accepted。
**Immediate downstream:** G5 only after G4.7 Gate PASS。
# 1. Work Package Topology
G4.6 PASS
→ G4.7-00 Authority / Repo Reconciliation + Pre-G5 Primitive Inventory
→ G4.7-01 Production RichText Layout Runtime
→ G4.7-02 Font Resource + Text Stack Profile
→ G4.7-03 Scene / Bounds / Resource Invalidation Integration
→ G4.7-04 Direct Reference + Production Render Integration
→ G4.7-05 Incremental EditRichText + Layout Locality
→ G4.7-06 Text Performance Playground + Structured-grid Proxy + Qualification Bundle
→ READY_FOR_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION
→ G4.7-07 Unified Physical Qualification + Cross-platform / G5 Workload Freeze / Gate Report
→ G5。
**Execution cadence:** G4.7-00…06 may proceed continuously after G4.6 PASS. RichText display/font/zoom/DPR physical checks are deferred until the entire layout/render/locality/performance implementation is code-complete and automated-verification-complete. G4.7-07 is the only blocking physical phase。
# 2. WP-G4.7-00 — Authority + Repository Reconciliation / Pre-G5 Primitive Inventory
**Goal:** 锁定 post-G4.6 repo reality，并证明 G5 前所有会改变核心 performance primitive 的 production workload都有明确 owner。
**Required inventory rows:** Shape/Vector；Image/Resource decode/materialization；Ink；Brush；Laser；Selection/Transform Overlay；Camera/Zoom；RichText；future Table proxy；ExternalSurface deferred boundary。
**Fail-closed rule:** 如果 Image/Resource 只有 static/fake placeholder，无法形成真实 replayable decode/materialization/resource-pressure workload，则当前 WP不得把问题偷偷塞进 G5；产出 ArchitectureFollowUpRequired / ExecutionClosureRequired 并保持 G4.7 Gate BLOCKED，直到 owner明确。
**Exit:** no second hidden pre-G5 performance primitive gap。
# 3. WP-G4.7-01 — Production RichText Layout Runtime
**Goal:** 从当前 canonical RichText read model materialize renderer-neutral RichTextLayoutService / equivalent production subsystem。
**Must cover:** paragraph/run/style consumption；derived line/fragment/shaped-run representation；local bounds；future editing geometry mapping seam；explicit layout context/constraint input；no Skia/native handle in stable contract。
**Forbidden:** no RichText width/height schema field；no TextEditSession；no platform editor。
**Evidence:** fixed-font deterministic layout fixtures + rebuild/replay equivalence。
# 4. WP-G4.7-02 — Font Resource + Text Stack Profile
**Goal:** 接入 explicit FontResourceId、exact (weight, italic) face与 unified Axiom text stack/profile。
**Must cover:** missing resource；missing exact face；missing glyph；no nearest-weight；no synthetic bold/italic；no system/browser fallback；resource generation tracking；deterministic mock resolver for CI；real bundled font resource for physical/golden。
**Exit:** same accepted font resource/input cannot acquire platform-dependent semantic meaning。
# 5. WP-G4.7-03 — Scene / Bounds / Resource Invalidation Integration
**Goal:** 将 text layout作为 Scene Core Geometry/Layout derived contribution接入 current RuntimeScene/Bounds/Spatial path。
**Required behavior:**
- EditRichText → affected layout/bounds/spatial contribution update；
- SetTransforms → reuse local layout，only world transform/bounds update；
- camera/zoom → no Scene/RichText layout rebuild；
- font Missing→Ready / Evicted→Ready → resource-driven derived invalidation，zero Operation；
- old/new visual contribution available for downstream Damage。
**Exit:** RichText不再是 renderer-only opaque placeholder；Scene能提供正确 conservative text bounds/dependency facts。
# 6. WP-G4.7-04 — Direct Reference + Production Render Integration
**Goal:** 同一 TextLayoutSnapshot可被 permanent Direct/NonTiled reference与 production Skia path消费。
**Tests:** reference plan deterministic；same layout source used by headless / Windows / Web / Android renderer path as applicable；transform/camera does not invoke layout service；missing-resource degraded rendering follows authority；no SemanticDocument read from normal Render Core frame path。
**Physical qualification deferred:** 本 WP 必须完成 bundled FontResource 的 automated reference/production parity、zoom/DPR matrix、missing→ready transition instrumentation、frame/screenshot capture hooks，并达到 qualification-ready。Windows/Web/Android 上 small/large text、mixed weight/style、25/100/400% zoom、DPR/resize、dense text、missing→ready 的真实视觉检查统一推迟到 **G4.7-07 Unified Physical Qualification**，不阻塞 locality/performance WPs。
# 7. WP-G4.7-05 — Incremental EditRichText + Layout Locality
**Goal:** 用 canonical EditRichText 直接制造真实 text edit workload，不依赖 G6 IME。
**Cases:** insert/delete in one paragraph；split/merge paragraph；inline style change；paragraph style change；one object among many；repeated small edit burst；resource-ready invalidation；transform-only negative control；camera-only negative control。
**Evidence:** affected layout object/paragraph counts；no unrelated RichText relayout；semantic/reference result exact；layout CPU observations；old/new bounds / SceneDelta evidence。
# 8. WP-G4.7-06 — Text Performance Playground + Structured-grid Proxy + Qualification Bundle
**Artifact:** Axiom Text Performance Playground 0.1。
本 WP 必须把阶段推进到 `CODE_COMPLETE + AUTOMATED_VERIFICATION_PASS + QUALIFICATION_ARTIFACT_READY`，并生成 exact revision/build manifest、bundled font/resource package、scenario selector、HUD/metrics、screenshot/trace/evidence export。完成后状态为 `READY_FOR_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION`，但仍不是 G4.7 Gate PASS。
**Workloads:** text-many-small；text-long；text-style-mixed；text-edit-local；text-font-cold-warm；text-transform；text-camera；structured-grid-proxy = Shape + RichText cell-like dense composition，**not Table semantic object**。
**HUD/metrics:** text object / paragraph / run / scalar count；layout requests/cache hit-miss；shaping/layout CPU；glyph/render-run count；font resource state/bytes；scene generation；layout generation；damage footprint observation；frame time；reference digest。
**Table future-proof evidence:** 至少一个 \~100K-object mixed Shape+RichText profile，证明 G5 将面对未来 cell-like density；不得由此定义 Table row/column/cell semantics。
# 9. WP-G4.7-07 — Unified Physical Qualification / Cross-platform Parity / G5 Workload Freeze / Gate Report
**All blocking physical checks happen here once.**
Windows / Web / Android 按 capability profile 使用同一 accepted bundled FontResource集中检查：
- small/large text；
- mixed weight/style；
- 25/100/400% zoom；
- DPR / resize；
- dense text / structured-grid proxy；
- missing→ready resource transition；
- wrong-face / fallback drift / layout jump / geometry defects；
- Direct/NonTiled reference vs production visual parity。
每次 run 必须绑定 exact revision/build id/hash、platform/device/profile、font/resource identity与 evidence export。失败后进入 P33 修复并仅重跑受影响 physical obligations。
Physical qualification完成后冻结 deterministic text corpus、layout/reference digests、font resource corpus、text edit traces、dense-grid proxy、cold/warm resource workload、physical screenshots/comparison、performance observations。
Gate report必须记录 exact accepted G4/G4.5/G4.6 dependencies、Pre-G5 Primitive Inventory verdict、any Image/Resource blocker/follow-up、text layout/profile versions、workload digests、Tier-A parity、regression status。
# 10. G4.7 Gate Exit Criteria
全部满足才允许 PASS：
- G4.6 Gate PASS recorded；
- production RichText layout path PASS；
- FontResource exact-face / no-fallback PASS；
- Scene/Bounds/Spatial integration PASS；
- Direct/NonTiled vs production render parity PASS；
- G4.7-07 Unified Physical Qualification completed with blocking text/font/zoom/DPR defects closed；
- EditRichText locality PASS；
- transform/camera negative-control PASS；
- resource-only invalidation causes zero canonical mutation；
- Text Performance Playground runnable；
- dense structured-grid proxy corpus replayable；
- Image/Resource primitive inventory resolved rather than hidden；
- Windows/Web/Android required parity PASS；
- G3/G4/G4.5/G4.6 regressions PASS；
- G5 text workload corpus frozen；
- Gate Report schema-valid PASS。
# 11. Explicitly Deferred to G6 / Future
TextEditSession；caret/selection interaction；IME composition；EditorProjection / platform offset mapping；native/DOM editor overlays；Clipboard；ExternalSurface；lifecycle/recovery；bidi schema；Table semantic model；RichText canonical TextBox sizing/wrapping fields not already accepted。
# 12. Downstream Contract
G4.6 Gate PASS
- G4.7 Gate PASS
- post-G4.7 text/resource workload corpus
→ G5 Large Canvas Optimization。
G5不得为了 benchmark改变 RichText layout/profile semantics、FontResource exact-face policy、derived invalidation ownership或 Direct/NonTiled reference result。
